quotes.text:
9.3 LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. EXCEPT (I) WITH RESPECT TO ANY BREACH OF ARTICLE 8 (CONFIDENTIALITY), (II) FOR THIRD PARTY
PENALTIES, COSTS AND EXPENSES AS SET FORTH IN SECTION 2.9, OR (III) FOR [***], TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, (A)

OR FORM OF ACTION, EVEN IF SUCH PARTY HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY THEREOF; AND (B) EACH PARTY’S TOTAL LIABILITY
TO THE OTHER PARTY UNDER THIS SUPPLY AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED [***]. SUTRO’S LIABITY TO SUTROVAX FOR THIRD PARTY
PENALTIES, COSTS AND EXPENSES UNDER SECTION 2.9 SHALL NOT EXCEED [***].

9.1.1 Indemnification by Sutro. Sutro hereby agrees, at its sole cost and expense, to defend, hold harmless and indemnify, to the extent permitted by
Applicable Law, (collectively, “ Indemnify ”) SutroVax and its Affiliates and their respective agents, directors, officers and employees of such Persons and
the respective successors and assigns of any of the foregoing (the “ SutroVax Indemnitees ”) from and against any and all liabilities, damages, penalties,
fines, costs and expenses (including, reasonable attorneys’ fees and other expenses of litigation) (collectively, “ Liabilities ”) resulting from suits, claims,
actions and demands, in each case brought by a Third Party (each, a “ Third-Party Claim ”) against any SutroVax Indemnitee and arising from or occurring
as a result of: [***].

9.1.2 Indemnification by SutroVax. SutroVax hereby agrees to Indemnify Sutro and its agents, directors, officers and employees and the respective
successors and assigns of any of the foregoing (the “ Sutro lndemnitees ”) from and against any and all Liabilities resulting from Third-Party Claims
against any Sutro Indemnitee arising from or occurring as a result of: [***].

Sections 9.1.1 and 9.1.2 contain indemnities with redacted subject matter; because Section 9.3 also contains a redacted carve-out, the extent to which indemnity exposure is capped cannot be confirmed from the visible text.

fields.value: SutroVax must purchase all Extract requirements from Sutro, subject to specified Alternate Supplier/CMO exceptions. SutroVax also has a first right to Alternate Supplier Extract capacity. Custom Reagents are expressly non-exclusive for SutroVax sourcing/manufacture.

quotes.text:
2.20 Extract Requirements. SutroVax agrees to purchase all its requirements of Extract from Sutro in accordance with this Agreement, except to the extent
SutroVax is allowed to purchase Extract from (a) Alternate Suppliers engaged by Sutro in accordance with Section 2.15 of this Agreement; (b) a CMO
engaged or established and authorized by Sutro under Section 3.l(d) of the License Agreement; or (c) a CMO authorized by Sutro under Section 3.l(e) of
the License Agreement. Manufacturing of Extracts in breach of this Section 2.20 shall be deemed a material breach of this Agreement and the License
Agreement by SutroVax.

2.15.4 Sutro/Third Party use of Alternate Supplier. Once the Alternate Supplier is qualified pursuant to this Section 2.15, SutroVax shall have the first right
(as between SutroVax and Sutro or Third Parties supplied or authorized by Sutro) to obtain Extract Manufactured by the Alternate Supplier up to the
Capacity established pursuant to the Transfer Addendum for a period ending the later of [***] or [***], and provided SutroVax commits to [***] or [***].

2.17 Manufacture of Custom Reagents. For clarity, SutroVax may Manufacture Custom Reagents itself or obtain supply thereof through a Third Party
independent of this Supply Agreement and nothing in this Supply Agreement is intended to restrict SutroVax from doing so.

ambiguities: Section 2.20 cross-refers to CMO rights under the License Agreement; the quoted text identifies the exceptions but the underlying License Agreement terms are not included here.
Section 2.15.4 redacts the period and commitment conditions for SutroVax’s first right to Alternate Supplier capacity.

payments.description: SutroVax must pay Sutro invoices for the Price for each Product shipment; Product Prices are set in the applicable Work Order and capped by a redacted percentage of Fully Burdened Manufacturing Costs.
payments.conditionNote: Due within [***] days after SutroVax receives an invoice for a shipment; shipment dates, invoice receipt dates, Work Order Prices and the payment period are not fixed in the text.

quotes.text:
3.1 Invoices. Sutro shall invoice SutroVax at the time of each shipment of Product(s) for the Price for such shipment. SutroVax will pay such invoices
within [***] days of receipt of invoice (including all required documentation) by SutroVax.

3.2 Prices. The Prices for the Products shall not exceed [***] of the Fully Burdened Manufacturing Costs of such Product at the time such Product is
manufactured and shall be set forth in the applicable Work Order.

ambiguities: The visible text redacts the percentage cap and omits the actual Work Order/Schedule 1 Prices.

payments.description: For Extract manufactured by a Third Party, including an Alternate Supplier, SutroVax must pay a Price based on Sutro’s out-of-pocket cost plus Sutro FTE relationship-management costs, subject to redacted caps/adjustments.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if Extract supplied to SutroVax is manufactured by a Third Party; invoice timing and quantities are not fixed.

quotes.text:
2.15.3 Price. To the extent Sutro or its Affiliate Manufactures Extract supplied to SutroVax, the Price (per unit volume or unit weight) under this Supply
Agreement and the Phase 3/Commercial Supply Agreement for such Extract shall not exceed [***] of the Fully Burdened Manufacturing Costs of such
Extract; and to the extent the Extract to be supplied to SutroVax is Manufactured by a Third Party (including the Alternate Supplier), the Price to be

charged to SutroVax under this Supply Agreement and the Phase 3/Commercial Supply Agreement for such Extract shall equal the amount Sutro paid
such Third Party for such Extract (“ OOP Cost ”) plus an amount reasonably calculated to cover Sutro’s FTE costs to procure and manage the relationship
with such Third Party, such amount not to exceed [***] of the OOP Cost for such Extract.

ambiguities: Section 2.15.3 redacts the percentage caps and later alternative price calculations, so no fixed amount can be extracted.

payments.description: For Other Extracts, the Price is the cost of materials plus Sutro labor at a redacted FTE rate for Sutro laboratory scientists.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if SutroVax places purchase orders for Other Extracts subject to an agreed Work Order and Sutro accepts or is required to accept them.

quotes.text:
2.16 Other Extracts. From time-to-time, subject to an agreed-upon Work Order, SutroVax may place purchase orders for quantities of research grade
extract derived from strains of E. Coli other than that set forth on Schedule 1 attached hereto (each an “ Other Extract ”). Sutro shall use Commercially
Reasonable Efforts to accept such purchase orders (and shall accept such purchase orders placed consistent with an agreed-upon Work Order) and
manufacture and supply to SutroVax such Other Extracts. For the purpose of calculating the Price for Other Extracts in accordance with this Section, the
Price will be the cost of materials and Sutro’s labor at an FTE rate of [***] per year for Sutro laboratory scientists.

ambiguities: Section 2.16 redacts the FTE rate and does not fix the cost of materials or quantities.

payments.description: SutroVax must pay taxes and duties assessed on its purchase or use of Products, excluding taxes based on Sutro’s income or gross receipts.
payments.conditionNote: Taxes depend on purchases/use and are separately identified on Sutro’s invoice; no invoice date or tax amount is fixed.

quotes.text:
3.4 Taxes. The Prices are exclusive of all Taxes. SutroVax will pay all taxes and duties that are assessed by any national, federal, state or local
governmental authority on SutroVax’s purchase or use of the Products, including, without limitation, sales, use, excise, value-added and withholding
taxes, but excluding any taxes based on Sutro’s income or gross receipts (collectively, “ Taxes ”). Sutro will separately identify all such Taxes on Sutro’s
invoice.

payments.description: SutroVax must bear Sutro’s expenses for certain Drug Master File support, additional data requested by Regulatory Authorities, and correction of deficiencies, subject to a pre-approved budget.
payments.conditionNote: Applies if the relevant regulatory filings, requests or deficiencies arise; amount depends on the approved budget and requested work.

quotes.text:
Sutro shall file such Drug Master File in coordination with
SutroVax’s efforts to file and prosecute the applicable regulatory filings to such Regulatory Authority and Sutro shall be responsible, at SutroVax’s sole
expense (subject to a budget reasonably approved in advance by SutroVax), for providing the applicable Regulatory Authorities with such additional data
as they may request (which may in some cases require Sutro to conduct additional studies), and for correcting any deficiencies of such Drug Master File
identified by such Regulatory Authority, in each case in a reasonably prompt and efficient manner so as to prevent any delay in obtaining Regulatory

ambiguities: The amount depends on future Regulatory Authority requests, deficiencies and a budget not included in the supplied text.

payments.description: Laboratory fees and expenses for Product conformance disputes are borne by Sutro if the Product is non-conforming, and by SutroVax if the Product conforms.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if the Parties submit a dispute to a Laboratory; payer depends on the Laboratory’s determination.

quotes.text:
The fees and expenses of the Laboratory making such determination shall be borne by Sutro, in the event that the Laboratory
determines that the Product was non-conforming and by SutroVax, in the event that the Laboratory determines that the Product did conform to the
Required Standards.

ambiguities: No Laboratory fees or dates are fixed.

payments.description: For non-conforming Product, Sutro bears reasonable return/destruction expense; SutroVax receives credit for amounts paid but must pay the applicable Price for replacement Product under Section 3.1.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only when Product is rejected or determined non-conforming; replacement Product payment follows invoice terms.

quotes.text:
Product that is either rejected by SutroVax as not meeting the Required Standards, or that is
determined by the Laboratory not to meet such Required Standards, shall, [***], be returned by SutroVax to Sutro, or destroyed pursuant to Applicable
Law, at Sutro’s reasonable expense. Sutro shall replace any non-conforming Product(s) within the shortest possible time. SutroVax shall have no
responsibility to Sutro for the amounts invoiced for non-conforming Product(s), and shall be credited for any amounts paid, but shall pay Sutro the
applicable Price for the replacement Product(s) under the terms of Section 3.1.

ambiguities: The clause contains a redaction after “shall,” and the replacement Product Price is not fixed in the supplied text.

payments.description: A Party whose breach causes a recall is responsible for recall costs and must reimburse the other Party as necessary; shared responsibility is allocated by contributory responsibility.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only if a recall results from a Party’s breach; amount depends on recall costs and responsibility allocation.

quotes.text:
In the event it
is determined that such a recall resulted from a breach by either Party of any of its representations, warranties, duties or obligations under this Supply
Agreement, such Party shall be responsible for the costs of the recall and shall reimburse the other Party as necessary; provided that if both Parties share
responsibility with respect to such recall, the costs shall be shared in the ratio of the Parties’ contributory responsibility.

ambiguities: Recall occurrence, costs and contributory responsibility are not fixed.
